fresh_schema_rule: Invent these unrelated fixtures anew. No task/corpus/stage reads, examples, expected outputs or retained task proof are qualifying inputs. Test descriptions here create no source program or proof.

cases.schema: scalar-only, three distinct parameters over Nat/Int/Bool
cases.exercise: Declaration-order parameters, reversed source environment, nested lets, both conditional branches and noncommutative arithmetic.
cases.pass: Universal exact compiled-run and wrapper equalities replay; comparisons remain Bool and Nat/Int operations preserve their own semantics.

cases.schema: record PulseMark { label:String, enabled:Bool, delta:Int }; record WrapMark { marker:Option(PulseMark), history:List(Option(PulseMark)) }
cases.exercise: Nested ordered nominal records, Option payload matches, construction/projection, map/filter with outer scalar/string/record captures and let-bound repeated uses.
cases.pass: Universal correspondence under exact layouts/adapters; no independent accepted record identity or hidden casts assumed.

cases.schema: record FoldMemo { state:Int, seen:Nat, chosen:Option(String) }; source parameters include List(Option(PulseMark))
cases.exercise: Left fold with record accumulator, branch payloads, helper calls and surrounding immutable captures.
cases.pass: Universal correspondence retains item/accumulator positions and every outer binder; no finite-list bound added.

cases.schema: Nat bound, scalar state and captured Option/List/record values
cases.exercise: Natural fold with index and accumulator referenced distinctly, nested let, map or helper use in a step.
cases.pass: Universal equality for every natural bound with exact Nat.rec order and no runtime fuel.

cases.schema: List(Result(Option(PulseMark),WrapMark)) and accepted finite Enum ToggleMark
cases.exercise: Nested Result/Option/List branches and enum constructors, typed equality and shape-correct payload handling.
cases.pass: All branch types and case order correspond universally; nominal identity and exact enum registry retained.

cases.exercise: Repeated named helper use, out-of-dependency-order source declarations, fold/map calls and captures passed as actual helper arguments.

cases.exercise: Exact fdiv, conversions, Bool-valued comparison, Unicode scalar construction, Option indexing and fixed sort/unique/list primitives.
cases.pass: Universal equality uses the same pinned primitive constants; independent closed sanity examples may supplement but cannot replace it.

cases.exercise: Mutate renderer output: noncommutative argument swap, changed scalar operator, changed comparison boundary, swapped Option/Result branch, item/accumulator swap, natural index/accumulator swap, altered record field order or nominal ID, missing captured variable.
cases.pass: Exact typing/layout or universal kernel correspondence rejects each semantically distinguishable mutation; no CHECKED packet is emitted.

Acceptance/goal/binding manifests change as required; accepted equality/guarantees still independently required. Renderer rejects accidental reference/body inputs.
